question: Eighteen months after approval of a platform's implementation framework, TSOs may propose changes to it. For which Europe-wide energy exchange platform may that change proposal also reopen the platform's basic principles (common governance, multilateral TSO-TSO model, common merit order lists), not just the implementation framework?

verdict.gold_reason: Article 21(5) allows a modification proposal "pursuant to paragraph 1 and of the principles set in paragraph 2". Paragraph 2 sets common governance, the multilateral TSO-TSO model and common merit order lists. Article 20(5) for the manual-activation platform refers only to paragraph 1, so the reference answer is correct.
